prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Seoul — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Seoul as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Seoul with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: inside a canvas bell tent at a glamping site — a low bed of white quilts, fairy lights, layered rugs and the door flap tied open onto the trees
Season: high summer — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a lingerie set strung with fine pearl chains draped from the bralette across the waist — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: lying on her front.
SUPPORT: she lies on her front, propped on her forearms.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; she is small in the lower part of the frame, the place rising above her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
LEGS: lower legs raised behind her, ankles loosely crossed.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

generation.note: Original PNG retained outside Git; SHA256 recorded.

acceptance: User selected world candidate 1; completion and normal main update authorized.

observations: Identity matches selected reference; correct image aspect.
No visible extra or disconnected limbs; visible hands naturally joined.
Some glossy facial highlights and recurring transparent outer layers exceed the requested soft facial finish and costume independence; retained without regeneration.
Lying prone, both forearms support chin; two bent legs and boots visible.
qa.cause: Glossy reference finish carried into edits; non-anatomy style deviations retained per workflow.
